verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an agency with an online filing flow (EAMS via SecureAccess Washington). However, none of the public guidance pages in the pack publish operating-hours windows, per-day limits, or session timeouts for that flow. The probe of the transactional portal shows only a login wall, with no published policy.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
